headline: Remember Road Rash?
title: Remember Road Rash | EA's Classic Bike Racing Game | Classic Games
video_script: Remember Road Rash? EA's bike racing game first came out in nineteen ninety one on the Sega Mega Drive. While racing, you could punch other riders and grab weapons like clubs to fight them off. Lots of players in India played the PC version. Outrunning the police and winning the race was the real fun! Did you play Road Rash? Comment below!
description: Road Rash (EA, 1991, Sega Mega Drive) - the classic bike racing game where you fight while you race.
